confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is least certain because peak-season rates vary widely. Beer assumes a 0.5 L serving. The FX figure came from a search summary that said the RBA table itself could not be read, so verify it on the RBA page before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Estimates are based on the Old Town and Kazimierz tourist areas, placed among Polish tourist cities and below Warsaw. Cocktail and wine anchors are bounded from the draft beer price (about 2.3x and 1.3x) because direct knowledge is weaker.
